segments.comment: questpgr.c com_pager_core auto-synopsis: the debug level-teleport menu takes a Barbarian to Bar-strt (quest.c on_start firsttime), then to the Oracle level and back, so on_start shows Bar nexttime. That entry has default output, a newline and no synopsis, so C promotes it to a window and writes '[text]' with newlines as spaces to message history (questpgr.c:582-609). Three ^P recalls show it; the game is then saved.
Restores the saved game. After the welcome --More-- and the debug-mode keep-save-file prompt (answered n), nine ^P recalls walk back through the restored message history past the synopsis line.
